name: native-coding-followup-and-clarification-on-the-same-mr
covers: coding follow-up recalls an earlier coding turn
model asks a question in a coding run and continues after the answer

steps.prompt: In GitLab project {{gitlab.project}}, clone the project and implement src/shout.js exporting function shout(text) that returns text.toUpperCase() + '!'. Add shout.test.js using node:test asserting shout('hello') === 'HELLO!'. Set package.json to use ES modules and test script 'node --test shout.test.js', without adding dependencies. Run npm test using the verification tool, then publish one unmerged MR targeting {{gitlab.targetBranch}}. Do not merge. Reply in plain text without Markdown, listing the changed filenames and verification result. Remember the conversation marker amber-lighthouse-731 for the next request.

In the same project and same MR, make this follow-up change. Add a regression in shout.test.js asserting shout('') === '!'; use single quotes for that expression. Preserve the hello regression. Run npm test with the verification tool and update the same unmerged MR. Do not merge or change unrelated files. Reply in plain text without Markdown, listing the verification result. Also add conversation-marker.txt containing only the conversation marker from my first request and a newline. Do not guess; use the retained conversation. Verify and publish this file in the same MR.
In the same project and same MR, add codename.txt containing only a codename and a newline. You do not know the codename: ask me for it with ask_user before you write the file. Do not guess.

continue The codename is teal-heron-42. Write codename.txt with it, keep every earlier change, run npm test with the verification tool and update the same unmerged MR. Do not merge. Reply in plain text without Markdown, listing the verification result.
